༄༅/ /grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa'i dgongs don rim bzhi lam slongs snying por dril ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa'i dgongs don rim bzhi lam slongs snying por dril ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ bde chen thugs rje'i dbang phyug ni/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir he ru kar/ /ston mdzad de la gus btud nas/ /mchog gi bsnyen pa'i man ngag bshad/ 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las 'byung ba'i man ngag gi rim pa/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa'i dgongs don rim bzhi lam slongs snying por dril ba ni 'di yin te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la/ chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa maṇ+ḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid do/ /dang po spyi dang 'dra ba las/ skyabs yul gyi gtso bo bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du byed pa gtso che/ mtha' cig tu nges bzung ni mi dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni rdor sems he ru ka'i lha sgom pa dang de'i yig brgya bzla ba'i cho ga ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa maṇ+ḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid gnyis las dang po'i spyi dang 'dra ba las/ skyabs yul gyi gtso bo ngo bo bla ma rnam pa yi dam gyi rnam pa can du byed do/ /'di la mchod yul gyi maṇ+ḍal 'cha' na/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa nas 'byung ba bzhin te/ tshogs khyad par can gsog pa'i phyir du spros pa la mos pa rnams kyis sgrub par bya ba nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni gnas khang srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yang khang dang bcas par gyur pa'i dbus su/ seng khri pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa'i sku can/ 'khor dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma drug cu rang rang gi gnas na bzhugs pa/ gzhan rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyang gzhal yas khang gi phyogs mtshams steng 'og phyi nang thams cad khyab par bzhugs pa la/

mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyi nang thams cad stibs par mos te/ phyag 'tshal/ skyabs 'gro/ mchod bstod rnams sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba drag tu gdab/ sku'i 'od zer las dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa bya/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ gsol gdab kyi sngon du/ sems bskyed sdom gzung gnyis dang*/ 'od zer gyi dbang bzhi'i rjes su/ chu dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ bzhi pa rnams kyi dngos gzhi rnams blang bar bya'o/ / mthar 'khor rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de rang nyid la thim/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo zhing*/ bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam btab bo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thun mong gi rnal 'byor dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis so/ /dang po la/ sngags kyi rang lam la 'jug pa thun mong gi rnal 'byor bskyed rim man ngag gi gnad la bslab pa dang*/ lam thams cad kyi thun mong du gol sa bcad cing thar pa'i 'jug ngogs su dkri ba lta ba man ngag gi gnad la bslab pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ mos pas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mngon gyur bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis kyi/ dang po mos sgom ni 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs las ji skad 'byung ba ltar/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i yan lag rnal 'byor dgu dang bcas pa thun bzhi sogs ji ltar rigs par sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed/ sbyang bya/ sbyang 'bras rnams so sor ngo sprad de ma yengs par bsgom pa la bslab cing*/ gtso bo'i don lha sgom pa yin kyang*/ bzlas pa la spro na/ grangs sam mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ci rigs pa mthar phyin phyin du bsgom pa yin no/ /'on kyang 'di tsam gyis lha sku sogs la gsal snang thob pa dang*/ brtan pa thob pa dang*/ mthar phyin pa ni bsags khyab can yin na ma gtogs gzhan la 'byung dka' bas/ mngon gyur sgom pa nges par dgos la/ 'on kyang de'i tshe bar chad mi 'jug cing ting nge 'dzin la 'dris par bya ba'i don dang*/

don gyi gtso bo tshogs rgya chen po bsog cing*/ sbyang bya sbyong byed kyi rten 'brel khyad par can 'grig pa'i don yin pas/ mos sgom 'di yang mchog tu gal che ba ni yin no/ /gnyis pa mngon gyur sgom pa ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa'i thabs/ lobs pa'i tshad/ brtan pa'i dus so/ /dang po la/ rnam pa la bslab pa/ go rim la bslab pa/ thun mtshams la bslab pa'o/ /dang po rnam pa la bslab pa ni/ bris sku mtshar ba zhig me long la sogs pa'i 'od dang ldan par byas la/ chu srang gnyis gsum du sems ma yengs shing mig rtse gcig tu blta/ yang de kha'i rnam pa yid la 'char bar byas te cung zad bsgom/ de ltar blta ba dang sgom pa spel mar byas pas/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi 'char tshul 'byung bas de dang mthun par bslab/ gnyis pa go rim la bslab pa ni/ dang po rim par bslab pa yin te/ gtso bo la gsal na yum gsal gdab pa sogs lha rnams la rim gyis bslab pa dang gzhal med khang dang*/ dur khrod dang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bar du re re bzhin du sbyangs/ so so la brtan pa thob na nyis sdebs gsum sdebs byed kyin sbyangs/ mthar 'khor lo ma lus pa cig car gsal ba'i bar du sbyangs/ gnyis pa ma nges par bslab pa ni/ res 'ga' lha nyung ngu dkyil 'khor rgya chung ngu la bslab/ res 'ga' lha mang ba dkyil 'khor rgya che ba la bslab/ de bzhin du sku mdog ma nges pa dang*/ sku'i tshad ma nges pa dang*/ zhal phyag bzhugs tshul sogs kyang ma nges pa la bslab pa dang*/ mang po nyung ngur bsdu ba dang*/ nyung ngu mang por spel ba sogs spro bsdu sna tshogs la bslab pas/ de dag so so thad kar gsal snang thob pa na/ go rim la lobs pa yin zhing*/ 'on kyang de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir yun sring ste skyar gyin sgom par yang bya'o/ /gsum pa thun mtshams la bslab pa ni/ sngar kyi de dag la ci rigs par lobs nas/ thun bzhi lta bur sgom zhing*/

de la brtan na gnyis sbrel te thun gnyis su bya/ de la brtan na mtshan ril po thun gcig tu byas nas bsgom mo/ /de la'ang brtan na nyin mtshan sbrel nas sgom pa sogs la rim gyis bslab pas/ mthar zhag mang por mi 'chor ba 'byung ngo*/ /de yang khams snyoms pa'i tshe nyin zhag gcig bar ma chad par mnyam bzhag thun gcig gi gnas pa byung na/ re zhig go rim la lobs par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lobs pa'i tshad la/ mi mnyam par lobs pa dang*/ mnyam par lobs pa dang*/ lhag par lobs pa gsum kha dog la lobs pa'i tshad yin la/ dmigs pa gang 'dod du bsgyur ba la dbang 'byor na/ go rim la lobs pa'i tshad dang*/ dus la 'phen pa gang btang ba de tsam du gnas na/ thun mtshams la lobs pa'i tshad do/ /gsum pa brtan pa'i tshad ni/ kha dog la brtan pa/ dbyibs la brtan pa/ grangs la brtan pa/ dus la brtan pa thob pa'i tshad de bzhi'o/ /de ltar na/ slob pa'i tshul gsum/ lobs pa'i tshad lnga/ brtan pa'i tshad bzhi ste bskyed rim mngon gyur sgom pa man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis so/ /gnyis pa gol sa bcad cing thar pa'i 'jug ngogs su dkri ba lta ba man ngag gi gnad la bslab pa la/ gtan la dbab bya/ gnas lugs yul gyi lta ba'i gnad gsum/ gtan la 'bebs byed rkyen kyi gnad gcig/gtan la 'bebs tshul yul can sgom pa'i gnad gsum/ go sa gcod pa ngo sprod pa'i gnas lnga ste/ de rnams so sor phral na lta ba man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis su bzhed do/ /dang po ni/ snang ba mtshan nyid med pa ste/ rgyu rkyen 'bras bu gnas lus longs spyod thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i don dang*/ 'khor ba rang bzhin med pa ste/ las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal gsum yang*/ rmi lam lta bur snang tsam ma gtogs ma grub pas/ rnam rtog tsam du shes par bya ba dang*/ rang sems zung du 'jug pa ste/ gdod nas spros bral gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes/ 'gyur med dbyings su gtan la 'bebs pa ste gsum mo/

/gnyis pa rkyen gyi gnad ni bla ma'i mos gus so/ /gsum pa'i gnad gsum ni/ snang grags thams cad sems snang du gtan la phab/ sems stong nyid brjod med rtsa bral du gtan la phab/ stong nyid bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su gtan la 'bebs pa'o/ /bzhi pa'i gnad lnga ni/ snang ba sems kyi dpe rmi lam/ snang yang ma grub pa'i dpe chu zla dang thal mo'i sgra lta bu/ rang bzhin dang snang ba gcig tha dad sogs spros pa las gol ba'i dpe mar me dang mar me'i 'od/ snang stong zung du 'jug pa'i dpe skyes bu'i lus la bltas nas ngo sprod pa/ kun khyab 'gyur med kyi dpe nam mkha' ste lnga'o/ /lta ba'i gnad 'di thams cad la gnad du reg na dbangapo rang log dang*/ ye shes rang shar dang*/ skye med thug phrad dang*/ so sor rang rig dang*/ mnyam rjes dbyings su thim pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /don la 'khor 'das ro mnyam lam du long ba yin no/ /'di nyid don gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams myong mchog dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yin la/ lta ba'i nyams myong rnam dag cig dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong rnam grangs de 'dra ba rnams gsang dbang dang*/ sher dbang gi ye shes kyi rigs su bzhed cing*/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong med par bskyed rim gyi nyams len dang zung du 'brel na bum dbang gi ye shes skyon med du 'dod do/ /bzhi pa'i ye shes de lam gyi phyag chen dngos yin zhing*/ gzhan gsum rjes mthun pa yin la/ thams cad la'ang dbang don nyams myong phyag rgya chen po zhes zer ro/ /dbang gi ye shes dang ma 'brel ba'i lta ba ni ji ltar mtho yang*/ phyag rgya chen po dngos dang rjes mthun pa gang yang min no/ /des na gdam pa 'di ni 'chad pa'i go rim la bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi bar 'dir ston mod kyi/

gzhan du na/ bskyed rim gyi thog mar bstan kyang rung*/ rdzogs rim nyams myong skyes pa'i rjes su bstan kyang rung bas go rim la nges pa med do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor ni rdzogs rim yin te/ 'di la rnal 'byor lam la brten pa dang*/ pho nya'i lam la brten pa'o/ /dang po la/ dmigs pa'i rtsa ba dang*/ dmigs pa'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ bskyed rim gyi 'jug thogs su sgom na lugs gnyis te/ brtan pa thob nas dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par bsgom/ las dang po pas dkyil 'khor bsdus te rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis bsgom/ bskyed rim gyi rjes dang ma 'brel na yang gnyis te/ brtan pa thob pas rang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang*/ snang grags thams cad lha sngags su shes pas bsgom/ las dang po pas/ stong pa'i ngang las phyag gnyis pa'i he ru kar langs te bsgom/ 'khor rnams yum yang rang la bstim ste dpa' bo gcig pa'i ngang nas sgom pa man ngag tu bzhed/ rgya gar gyi mkhas grub phyis byung ba rnams ni/ gtum mo sgom pa'i tshe lha sku kha sbyor sgom pa zab par bzhed kyin 'dugagang ltar rang lus lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu de'i lus kyi dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan spyi dang 'dra ba/ mun pa'i khams kyi cung zad slan pa/ yar sna tshangs bug dang*/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ sboms su mthe'u chung ngam gung 'dzub kyi tshad tsam pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po rak+tas cung zad rlan pa dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po kun+das cung zad rlan pa/ dbu ma dang gsum bzhibs kyi tshul can/ 'khor lo bzhi sogs spyi dang mthun pa las/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi nang skor rtsa 'dab brgyad la g.yon skor gyi/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha /phyi skor lnga bcu nga drug la/ g.yon skor gyi gsal byed so bzhi/ dbyangs yig bcu drug dang*/ dbyangs ring drug /'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus kyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang du oṃ yig ste/

'khor lo dang yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar ser kha gyen du phyogs pa'o/ /snying ga'i 'khor lo 'dab brgyad kyi phyogs bzhir/ a i u e/ mtshams bzhir/ ya ra la wa/ dbus su hūṃ/ thams cad kha dog sngon po kha mthur du phyogs pa'o/ /mgrin pa'i nang skor bzhi la ā ī ū ai/ phyi skor bcu gnyis la ma ning bzhi spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis/ dbus su oṃ/ thams cad kha dog dmar po gyen du phyogs pa'o/ /spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis la dbyangs yig bcu drug tshar gnyis/ dbus su haṃ/ thams cad kha dog dkar po mthur du phyogs pa'o/ /gshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ dbu ma'i mas snar k+ṣa yig dmar nag /ro rkyang gnyis la dbyangs gsal so sor 'god pa'am/ gsal byed dmar po gnyis dang*/ dbyangs dkar po re re spel nas brtsegs pa/ rkyang ma mas sna nas yar 'god la/ ro ma la yas sna nas mar 'god do/ /dpyid thig ltar na snying ga'i hūṃ yang snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang gi yang rtsa chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i dbus su chud par sgom dgos so/ /de ltar bshad pa de ni yi ge 'god pa rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'bring po ltar na ro rkyang dang rtsa 'dab kyi yi ge'i dod du thig le tsam sgom pa yin la/ bsdus pa la ni de rnams la yi ge thig le gnyis ka spangs nas/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lte ba'i yi ge bzhi dang*/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i k+ṣa yig tsam gsal 'debs pa yin no/ /de dag lan gcig gsal legs par btab nas/ rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe haṃ nas k+ṣa'i bar dang gnas pa'i tshe lte ba'i aṃ dang*/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe k+ṣa nas haṃ gi bar gsal btab ste/ rim pa de nyid yang yang sgom par byed pa ni rgyud kyi rim pa kho na'i man ngag dmigs pa'i rtsa ba bzhi rnal 'byor te dmigs pa dang po'o/ /༈ de nas dmigs pa re gsal btab nas/ bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor sgom pas/ gshang lam gyi rlung g.yos/

k+ṣa yig bskul/ de las me 'bar ba dbu ma nas song ste lte ba'i aṃ yig la phoga.aṃ las me 'bar/ lte ba'i 'khor lo me'i 'od zer gyis khyab/ lcags bsregs pa ltar dmar lhang gis song*/ reg bya shin tu tsha ba bzod dka' bar gyur par bsam/ de nas me lce glog gi zer ma lta bu ro ma nas song*/ snying ga'i 'khor lo snga bzhin bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song*/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo yang bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song*/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo yang bsregs/ haṃ yig zhu ba las byang chub kyi sems drag tu babs te/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang zhing*/ sngar me lce bsregs pas dri ma dang ljan ljin tshigaskabs 'dir byang chub kyi sems kyi gang bas me lce'i tsha gdung zhi zhing bkrus pas rtsa yig rnams snga ma las kyang dwangs shing gsal ba 'od 'phro bar gyur par bsam/ de nas byang chub kyi sems g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo bsos/ yang rkyang ma nas babs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo bsos/ yang rkyang ma bas babs/ lte ba'i 'khor lo bsos shing aṃ la thim pa/ aṃ las me lce shin tu phra ba gsal ba 'od 'tsher ba zhig dbu ma'i nang du je ring je ring la 'bar te/ snying ga'i hūṃ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ phugaspyi bo'i haṃ la bsnun/ me lce spyi bo nas dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo phye nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i brgyud la 'gro 'ong bya ste/ de yang me lce mkha' dbyings gang ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku las bdud rtsi len rgyu yin kyang*/ las dang po pas dmigs pa mi gsal na/ sangs rgyas byang sems zhi khro yab yum thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig tu 'dus/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur pa mdun gyi nam mkha' bzhugs/ me lce de de'i shangs bug g.yas pa nas zhugs/ sku lus kyi rtsa 'khor bzhi sogs kyi dwangs ma rnams zhu zhing*/ me lce dang lhan cig gyen du log nas shangs bug g.yon nas byung*/

gtum mo'i 'od snang de dang 'dres pa'i byang chub kyi sems rgyal ba sras bcas 'dus pa'i ngo bo rnams/ rang gi spyi bo tshangs bug nas zhugs haṃ la thim/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems dkar zhing sil la 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ dar dkar po'i snal ma brkyang pa lta bu'am/ thig pa phra mo brgyud mar 'bab pa'i tshul gyis byung*/ mgrin pa'i oṃ dang snying ga'i hūṃ gang*/ de las babs pa lte ba'i aṃ la sib sib thim pas gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi bde ba rgyud la skyes par mos/ de ltar na de yan chad tshar gcig sgom dgos shing*/ de nas thun rdzogs kyi bar la dbu ma'i nang gi 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa de kho na yang yang gsal 'debs shing*/ gang la sems 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ spyi bo nas 'ong ba'i byang chub kyi sems snying ga'i hūṃ brgyud nas lte ba'i aṃ la sku khrus gsol ba nyid la dmigs pa gtod dgos pa yin zhing*/ de yang snying ga nas mthur du gsal ba'i sor bzhi tsam la dmigs pa gtod gsungs te/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas/ lte ba dang snying ga gnyis la re mos kyi sems gzungs na legs shing*/ de'i yang lte ba gtso che'o/ /da lta lag len la 'di ltar mdzad de/ rlung thengs gcig la 'khor lo bzhi'i yig 'bru rnams brkyar te gsal btab nas/ 'bar 'dzag gi dmigs pa tshar gcig bsgom/ de nas rlung thengs gnyis dpyid thig kha sbyor la sems 'dzin pa ste mdzad/ de rjes rlung thengs gcig mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis ngal gso ste de nyid slar nas slar tu goms par byed pa'o/ /'di ni sngags rim gyi rnam pa lam du byed pa rtsa rlung thig le cha mnyam pa'i man ngag gtum mo'i rnal 'byor te/ dmigs pa gnyis pa'o/ /༈ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud la 'gro 'ong byed pa'i dmigs pa yan chad sngar bzhin tshar gcig gsal btab/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig zhu ba'i rgyun mgrin par babs pas longs spyod kyi 'khor lo khengs pa la sems gtad lam dus kyi dga' ba'i ye shes skyes par mos/

de bzhin du de las babs te snying ga'i 'khor lo khengs/ mchog dga'/ de las babs te lte ba'i 'khor lo khengs/ khyad dga' de las babs te gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo khengs/ byang chub sems kyi bgrod pas nor bu yan chad khyab par bsam/ lhan skyes so/ /'di rnams la cung zad rlung gi rnal 'byor byang ba yin na/ dmigs pa gang du gtod pa'i gnas su so so'i bum can sbyor dgos pa yin la/ shin tu las dang po pas ni lte ba'i bum can dngos su bzung nas gnad de dag tu rlung 'dus par mos pa tsam byed pa yin no/ /'di ni thig le'i rnal 'byor yin la/ ye shes kyi rim pa'i rnam pa lam du byed pa ste dmigs pa gsum pa'o/ /༈ de nas rdo rje nor bu byang chub kyi sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i thig les yongs su gang pa las rtsa 'khor de byang chub kyi sems gyi gang ba'i dbus na/ chu la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin lhag par gsal ba'i thig le la sems gtad de/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba'i dga' ba'o/ /de nyid yang rim gyis spos te/ nor bu nas lte ba'i bar la cha bzhis dang po'i dga' ba bzhi/ de nas snying ga'i bar la mchog dga' bzhi/ de nas mgrin pa'i bar la khyad dga' bzhi/ de nas gtsug tor gyi bar la lhan skyes bzhi skyes par mos/ 'di thig le'i rnal 'byor yin la dmigs pa bzhi pa'o// ༈ yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud la 'gro 'ong gi bar sngar bzhin bsgom/ gtum mo spyi bo'i bar du 'bar ba yang rgyun mi 'chad/ byang chub kyi sems nor bu'i bar du bab pa yang rgyun mi 'chad cing*/ nor bu nas yar log ste spyi bo'i bar du 'gro ba yang rgyun mi 'chad pa la sems cung zad gtad/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi 'od zer gyis rang lus dang snang ba thams cad khyab pas de'i bdag nyid du gyur/ de rnams thams cad me long la ha btab pa dbus su 'dus nas yal ba'i tshul gyis 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang du thim zhing*/

de'i ngang der bzo bcos dang bral bar ring du mnyam par bzhag la/ slar yang chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du lha sku gsal stong rtsa yig byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis khyab pa dang bcas par sngar bzhin du langs te/ zung 'jug he ru ka'i snang cha la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /'di ni gtum mo la brten nas rjes zhig sgom pa ste/ dmigs pa lnga pa'o/ /༈ de gnyis ni 'bras bu gsang rim gyi rnam pa lam byed yin te/ dmigs pa phyi ma 'di gnyis la ro rkyang gi lam nas 'bar 'dzag byed pa'i dmigs pa de mi dgos shing*/ dmigs pa 'di dag las dang po pas sgom na/ song tshod la thams cad rgyud kyi rim pa'i dmigs par song yang*/ rim pa phyi ma gsum gyi rnam pa lam byed dang mos sgom du gyur pa yin zhing*/ so so dang rjes mthun gyi nyams rtogs kyang skye ba yin no/ /des na 'di la gtum mo kho na la brten nas rim pa bzhi'i lam thams cad rdzogs pa'i phyir/ gtum mo lam rdzogs zhes dang*/ gtum mo lam longs zhes kyang 'ga' zh-ig tu grags shing*/ de la gtum mo zhes sgra yangs par byas na rdzogs rim spyi'i ming yin kyang*/ sgra dog par byas te spyi ming bye brag la btags pa ni/ nang gi mi dmigs la brjod cing*/ de'i gtso bo yang 'khor lo bzhi pa 'di yin te/ sdom pa 'byung ba dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ kha sbyor thig le rnams las ches gsal zhing rgyas par gsungs pa nyid do/ /༈ yang 'di la rgyas par spong sgom du byas na/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lnga dang ni/ /yi ge lnga dang rtsa 'dab dang*/ /ro rkyang rnams kyi yi ge la/ /sde tshan brgyad de kun sdoms dang*/ /rlung gi 'gro 'ong bslab pa ste/ /nyer gsum dmigs pa dang po la'o/ /k+ṣa yig 'bar dang ro rkyang gi /lam las 'gro zhing 'ong pa la/ /'khor lo bzhi la re re yin/ /de bzhin dbu ma'i 'bar 'dzag la/ /brgyad de bcu bdun gnyis la'o/ /gsum pa la ni yas bab bzhi/

/bzhi pa mas brtan bcu drug dang*/ /'bar 'dzag mas brtan 'od 'phro thim/ /'od gsal lha skur ldang ste bdun/ /kun sdom drug cu rtsa dgu'o/ /zhes nyams 'khrid du skyod pa'i lag len no/ /spyir spong sgom gyi dmigs pa'i rim pa la/ gang zag gi blo rigs dang bstun pas nges pa med kyang*/ dam pa snga ma rnams kyi phyag bzhed kyi rgyun la rgyas pa ni de ltar yin la/ phyag bzhed bsdus pa'i skabs ni dmigs pa bzhi po nyid dmigs skor re re'o/ /gnyis pa dmigs pa'i yan lag man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis su bzhed de/ rlung man ngag gi gnad gsum mi rtogs pa man ngag gi gnad gsum/ thig le man ngag gi gnad gsum/ gtum mo man ngag gi gnad gsum mo/ /dang po la gsum las/ drag po la bslabs pa ni/ rtsa gsum spyi dang mthun pa lte 'og tu a yig dmar po/ steng rlung drag tu mnan/ 'og rlung lan gsum drag tu drangs/ lte bar sdigs shing bzung*/ a de sol me bus pa bzhin/ dmar ngar ngar ba cung zad 'bar ba snyam byed pa la sems gtad/ rngub chung gis gzhal ba lan gsum byed/ ro stod na ba sogs byung na gegs sel ltar bsam/ gzhil ba re tsam byas nas me lce 'bar ba dbu mar song ste/ dbu ma 'dar khril khril ba bsgom/ des drag rlung de cung zad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa zhi ba la bslab pa ni/ 'jam rlung bag tsam bzung*/ lte bar aṃ dmar po/ sna ba'i thad tsam gyi mgo bo'i dbus su hūṃ nag po/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po/ rlung phyir 'gro haṃ la 'phog nang du yong ba hūṃ la 'phog lte bar gzung ba aṃ la 'phog pas yig 'bru so so'i rang sgra 'khar rnga rdungs pa bzhin byung bar bsam/ res 'ga' sna bug sgong lkogs khog stong 'dra ba'i nang du/ rlung du ba lta bus gang ba la sems gtad/ des rlung bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ gsum pa dgang thon la bslab pa ni/ rang lus khog stong zo ba zhabs med lta bu/ rlung phyir byung ba'i skabs 'og phyogs kyi rlung thams cad zo ba'i kha lta bu de nas steng du mthon te nam mkhar yal bar bsam/

nang du dgang ba'i skabs/ steng phyogs nas rlung thams cad lus nang brgyud/ mthur du babs te 'og phyogs su yal bar bsam/ rlung phyir 'dzin nang 'dzin spel mar byed/ mig steng gi nam mkhar bgrad/ res 'ga' mi rtog pa'i ngang nas kyang byed/ 'dis rlung gegs dang bying rgod thams cad sel zhing*/ ldang ba yang ba sogs gnas skabs kyi yon tan mang du bskyed do/ /gnyis pa mi rtog pa sgom pa la yang gsum gyi dang po rtog bcas la rten nas rtog med sgom pa ni/ dhū tī kha dog dkar po'i nang du thig le dkar po zhig yar 'gril mar 'gril 'gro 'ong byed pa la sems drag tu gtad/ yang ngal gso'i tshul du rig pa lhod kyis klod la bzhagade ka yang yang bsgoms pas mi ring bar mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin nam skyes cha med pa la thogs babs su skye/ gnyis pa zhud dbyung ba ni/ rtog pa ched gtad mi dgos par ji tsam 'phro ba thams cad ngos zin par byas nas/ da ci nas 'das pa'i dus la ji tsam skyes/ da lta ji tsam skye yin 'dugad ji tsam skye bar 'gyur zhes gang nas gang du 'phro yang yang rtags pas/ 'phro ba thang chad nas mi rtog par rang shugs kyis 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa mi rtog pa btsan thabs su sgom pa ni/ shing bu rde'u sogs snang ba gang shar cig la sems yud de bzhagares 'ga' sgrim res 'ga' klod/ phal cher ma sgrims ma klod pa yud de ba de kha bsgom/ rnam rtog 'phro na 'phro ba de ka 'khrul snang du shes par bya'o/ /de thams cad la thun mtshams su snang ba gang shar la shes pa ngos bzung nas lhod kyi klod pa gal che/ gsum pa thig le man ngag gi gnad la yang gsum las/ dang po kha dog la bslab pa ni/ lag pa pus 'khyud ltar bca'/ gsang ba'i sna rtser zla ba la hūṃ/ dbu ma'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du thig le dngul chu'i gzugs can/ rlung kha sbyor bzung bas/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis rlung g.yos nas/

thig le dbu ma'i nang nas mar nar gyi babs/ dbu ma'i nang na 'od kyi thig le skya shar re ba la sems gtad/ gnyis pa dbyibs la bslab pa ni/ snying gar nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du rdo rje dmar po rtse gcig pa/ de'i lte ba'am mas rtser thig le dkar po gcig bsgom/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe zla ba'i bu ga nas 'gro/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe yang de nas 'jug gnas pa'i skabs thig le la thim par bsam/ gsum pa 'phen rkyang la bslab pa ni/ snying ga'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su thig le dkar po sran rdog tsam/ de steng gi zla ba phug nas yar song*/ tshangs bug nas thon/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du song bar bsam/ yang mar log nas/ spyi bo sogs sngar gyi lam nas zhugs/ snying kha'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du sleb/de bzhin du bu ga dgu dang phyogs bcu thams cad la sbyar ro/ /bzhi pa gtum mo'i man ngag gi gnad la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos bzhi/ 'phros kyi man ngag dang gsum mo/ /dang po la srung 'khor tshogs bsog /lus sbyangs pa gsum mo/ /dang po ni rang gi snying gar zla ba la rdo rje dmar skya bsgoms/ rlung phyir bsal bas snying ga'i rdo rje las rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros sna sgo nas phyir byung*/ mkha' dbyings thams cad 'tshub mas khengs pa bzhin du rdo rjes khengs/ de rnams nyid phyi rol steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad las rdul chags pa'i tshul gyis chags pa/ de rnams kyi phyed tsam rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur du gyur par bsam la/ rlung phyir cung zad bzung*/ rlung rngubs pas rdo rje'i rdul gyi phyed tsam bar snang la yod pa rnams sna bug nas zhugs te lus nang du song*/ rlung nang du song bas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi phyi nang thams cad rdo rje'i dra bas go mtshams med par gtams/ de ltar yang yang bsgom pa'o/ /hūṃ gi dod du he ru ka lhan skyes khro bo sgom pa yang yod do/

/gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying gar ngo bo bla ma rnam pa bde mchog lhan skyes bsgom/ de la mos gus dung ba bya/ rlung phyir bus pa'i skabs de rang gi sna sgo nas rgyangs kyi byon nas/ spyi bo'i steg mtho tsam gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du bzhugs/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe sna bug nas zhugs te snying gar byon/ rlung phyi 'dzin nang 'dzin gyi skabs yid kyi mchod pa dang*/ mos gus dang gsol 'debs bya'o/ /gsum pa ni lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun bca'/ rlung khams sbyor drag po lan gcig bya/ de rjes steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bcings pa'i ngang nas/ lag pa phur shud 'phen thabs dang*/ rkang pa re mos sprug cing bshud/ /ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu zhing dkrug /mgo bo phyogs bzhir bskor zhing 'phangs/ /lto ba skor zhing bcol dang sdig /rlung ni kha nas sgra bcas btang*/ /zhes pa'i lus sbyongs nyid ci 'grub byed pa yin no/ /'di rnams zhal gdams phyogs cig pa'i stabs kyis skabs 'dir bshad pa tsam yin gyi/ sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum po ni/ gong gi gtum mo rgyas pa'i skabs kyi sngon 'gror sbyor ba'am/ thog ma'i skabs su sbyar kyang shin tu legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum gyi/ thugs kyi gtum mo ni/ gtso bor sems bde stong du bsgyur byed do/ /lus gnad me thab drug pa zhing bcas la/ lte bar k+ṣa dmar nag la dmigs nas rlung drag tu bcun pas/ lte ba nas me lce dmar breng nge ba dang*/ de'i 'od kyi lus thams cad khyab par bsgom/ drod bskyed pa dam tshig gi gtum mo'o/ /dbu ma'i lte bar k+ṣa dmar po/ yas sna spyi bo nas smin mtshams su 'khyogs pa'i bar du thig le dkar po/ thig le des smin mtshams spyi bo'i bar la phar 'gril tshul 'gril lan drug bdun byas nas slar spyi bo nas brgyud dbu ma'i nang du mar lhung ba na/ mkhar ba chus gang ba la dbyug gus bsnun pa ltar cong sgra grag cing lte ba'i k+ṣa la reg pas stem gyi zhu nas chi li li khol/

yang yar 'gril k+ṣa dang bral ma thag skya ril gyi song ste spyi bo'i bar du song*/ de ltar lan mang du bsgom/ bde ba bskyed pa chos kyi phyag rgya'i gtum mo'o/ /de nas nam mkha' stong pa la smin mtshams nas khru gang tsam gyi tshad du mig 'gyur med du lta/ sems res 'ga' sgrim res 'ga' klod/ de las du ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ngo*/ /bde ba mi rtog par bsgyur ba phyag rgya chen po'i gtum mo'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi gtum mo ni/ gtso bo rlung dag byed de rtsa gsum spyi dang mthun pa las/ lte ba'i thad dbu ma'i nang du aṃ daṃ baṃ yig dmar po/ ro rkyang sne gnyis dbu ma'i nang du tshud tsam bsgom mo/ /bum can bzung*/ lto ba g.yas g.yon du bskor bas dbu ma bsrubs/ baṃ las me byung bar bsam/ ro stod na ba sogs gegs byung na bsal/ de ltar bsgom pas mi rtog pa ci rigs pa shugs la skye'o/ /de ni reg pa drod kyi gtum mo'o/ /dbu ma'i nang spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du byang chub kyi sems srad bu dkar po brkyang pa lta bu skya na re 'dugadabugs phyir 'gro nang 'gro de la bdar bas bde breng nge 'dug cing*/ thig le de'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang gsal seng nge ba la sems gtad/ de ni phra ba gsal ba'i gtum mo'o/ /rlung nang du yod pa'i skabs thig le'i srad bu de'i sne gnyis nas chad nas lte bar gru gu bzhin du 'gril/ nang du gnas tsa na bde ril le 'dugade'i 'od phog pas rang lus yal la khad khad pa la sems gtad cing*/ phyir 'gro tsa na rgyangs kyis song nas sna sgo nas mthon/ yang nang du 'ong tsa na yas sne nas hril gyi 'gril/ lte bar sleb pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom la cung zad bde ba yid la byed/ shin tu phra ba bde ba'i gtum mo'o/ /gsum pa sku'i gtum mo ni/ gtso bor rtsa mdud grol phyir te/ spyir lus sbyangs 'khrul 'khor 'dug stang gsum dang*/ sbyor ba kho na gal che bsgom pa'i skabs su/

lus gnad lag pa gnyis gnya' bar bsnol/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge lnga dang bcas pa bsgom/ rlung bzung ba dang 'bar 'dzag sogs gzhan rtsa ba'i gtum mo dang 'dra/ k+ṣa las me 'bar zhing byang chub kyi sems k+ṣa la babs par bsgom/ de nas rlung thengs 'ga' song ba'am spong sgom du byed na/ zhag 'ga' song ba na snying ga'i hūṃ zhu nas k+ṣa la thim/ mgrin pa'i oṃ dang k+ṣa 'bar 'dzag byed par bsam/ oṃ yang zhu nas k+ṣa la thim/ haṃ dang k+ṣa 'bar 'dzag byed par bsam/ mthar haṃ yig nas nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar du byang chub kyi sems kyi khrig mer gyis gang bar bsgom/ bem po'i rlung gsal ba'i rlung du bsgyur ba'i gtum mo'o/ /de nas thun re re'i mgo la de lta bu bsgoms nas/ de rjes su rtog bcas kyi dmigs pa spangs te/ mig dang sems mdun gyi nam mkha' la g.yo med du lta ba dang*/ lta stangs smad nas rig pa lte bar blta ba gnyis re mos su bsgoms/ des gsal ba bde bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'khor lo bzhi'i thig le yig 'bru'i gzugs can rnams je dwangs je dwangs nam mkha' la yal bar bsams pas/ bde nyams mthug po de yang dbyings su thim ste/ bde ba la zhen pa med par 'gyur zhing*/ lkog gyur mang po glo bur du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas/ nyams gsum po ci rigs pa 'byung ste/ rang bzhin gyi nyams zhes bya ba bde bas drang ba'i bying ba chen po 'byung*/ rtog pa'i nyams zhes bya ba gsal bas drangs pa'i nyon mongs drag po ldang ba sogs yod/ 'od gsal gyi nyams zhes bya ba bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum cha mnyam zhing 'dzin zhen dang bral ba 'byung*/ dang po nyams skyon can yin pas skyon med du bsrongs dgos te/ bying na shes pa hur phyung*/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi brten pas sel/ rgod na gang 'phro ba de nyid rtsad bcad pas dbyings su dge bar 'gyur/

nyon mongs la sogs pa gang yin thams cad sems kyi snang ba dang nyams su shes na/ sgom lug las rang sar grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa 'phros don gyi gdams ngag ni/ de ltar sgom pas rmi nyams sna tshogs pa 'byung zhing*/ de rnams la blang dor dgag sgrub dga' sdug gang yang med par sems tsam du shes par bya/ de rmi dus yod na de nas 'dun pas mtshams sbyar te/ do nub rmi lam ngos zin par bya/ der yang lam rim pa gnyis nyams su blang bar bya/ zhes yang yang 'dun pa btad cing*/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor goms par byas pas rmi lam la rmi lam du shes shing*/ rmi lam du rim pa gnyis sgom pa 'byung ba yin no/ /de la dang por rim pa gnyis cung zad goms nas rtsa rlung thig le'i nus pas tha mal gyi rmi lam 'khrugs te/ rmi nyams sna tshogs pa shar ba'i skabs der de ltar sgom na bogs chod che ba yin gyi/ rmi lam gyi snang zhen tha mal pa sa 'dzags rdul 'dzags su yod pa'i skabs la/ rmi lam gyi gdams pa logs pa sgom kyang rtsa ba lhongs pa 'byung dka' zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang khams kyi rim pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges par snang ngo*/ /rmi lam gyi gdams ngag go /de bzhin du nyin par gtum mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor sgom pa'i bar bar du/ bde gsal mi rtog pa la lhan lhan gnas pa zhig yod pa/ de'i rang bzhin rtsa bral du shes pas mnyam par bzhag /gnyid du 'gro khar yang lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim dang de gnyis spel gyin bsgom/ de ltar sgom pas rmi lam med par gnyid mthug po la 'od gsal 'char ba yang srid/ stes dbang bgugs pa ma gtogs dang por dbang 'byor ba cung zad dka'/ rmi lam du gtum mo dang*/ de'i nyams kyi 'od gsal dran nas bsgom pas rkyen byas te rmi lam sangs/ gnyid mthug po'i 'od gsal mtha' dbus med par ci 'dod du skyong thub pa 'byung ste/ 'di lan gcig byung nas ci 'dod du rang dbang 'byor pa shas che/

'di'i mtshams nas gnyid mthug po'i 'od gsal sgom bogs che bar bzhed do/ /gnyid mthug po'i 'od gsal gyi gdams pa'o/ /de ltar gnyid sad dus dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ gnyid mthug po gsum la rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor rgyun mi 'chad par sgom thub pa des/ ring por mi thogs pa drod thob par 'gyur la/ de nas spyod pa gsum spyad pas/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin zhing*/ 'on kyang spyod pa gsum ma spyad pa dang*/ rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa ma brtan par 'chi ba'i dus byed na/ gong du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ /'di la rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*/ kha sbyor dang gdan bzhi rnams kyi dngos bstan las 'byung ba yin te/ grags che bas rgyas par gzhan du shes la/ 'dir 'pho dmigs kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ tho tsam brjod na/ 'pho ba'i dgos kyi lha'am/ yi dam gyi lha gang yin par bdag nyid bsgom/ bu ga dgu la sgo drug yod pa dang*/ gsang ba'i sgo gsum shes pa 'pho ba'i sgo gsum rnams rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon rnams kyi dgag nas/ bum pa can gyi rnal 'byor ci rigs pa sgom par bya'o/ /sngar gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la rang byan chud pa yin na des chog /de ltar min na 'pho ba'i sngon 'gro nyid la gsungs pa'i gtum mo 'khor lo gnyis pa de cung zad byang bar bsgom/ de nas khyogs dang khyer byed ces bya ba/ dgang ba dang dbyung ba'i rlung la ci rigs par bslab/ de nas dngos gzhi snying gar yi ge bkod pa la/ rgyas pa yi ge bdun pa dang*/ 'bring po lnga pa dang*/ bsdus pa gsum pa dang*/ shin tu bsdus pa yi ge gcig pa yin te/ hi kra gi sgra dang bcas te lte ba'i gtum mos bskul te 'pho ba dang*/ ka hi'i sgras snying gar ngal gso ba la shin tu gom par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor 'di la rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin du so so'i rtags thon par sbyangs shing 'byongs na/

gong du 'pho ba mchog de 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ de'i steng du bskyed rim brtan na sngags la nus pa grub/ rang gi lha sngags kyi byin rlabs dang gzi byin kha ma gri zhing*/ 'dod pa'i lha la snang ba thob pas sgrubs na/ pha rol gyi grong du 'jug pa yang sgrub tu rung ba yin no/ /so so'i rtags ji bzhin ma thon rung*/ thun sgom cung zad cung zad byas pas kyang gong 'pho phal ba 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa 'pho dmigs bsdus pa ni/ lus gnad bcas la/ lte bar sa/ snying gar chu/ mgrin par me/ mgo bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam/ de rnams kyi dbus dbu mas phug pa/ dbu ma'i steng du thig le dkar po bye'u'i sgong nga tsam rlung kha sbyor du bzung*/ 'og rlung drag tu gcun pas/ sa chu la thim/ chu me la/ me rlung la/ rlung thig le la thim/ rtsa dbu ma thung ril li li song lus kyang smad nas rim pas yal/ thig le spyi gtsug nas thon te stong pa'i dbyings su thim/ dbyings rig bsres la bzhagayang na rang gang mos su 'phos pas kyang chog go /ma sbyangs pa btsan thabs su 'pho dgos byung na'ang 'dis rung*/ 'pho ba'i gdam ngag go /'pho ba'i mtshams sbyar kyang rung ma sbyar kyang rung dam tshig dang ldan pa lam sgom pa 'phro can rnams/ da ltar nas snang ba thams cad la bar do'i 'dun pa sbyangs shing*/ bar dor lha dang bla ma dang lam rim pa gnyis dbang dang bcas pa dran par bya'o/ / zhes 'dun pa yang yang sbyangs/ de'i stobs kyis rmi lam du 'char/ de ltar na bar dor yang 'byung ste de yang bar dor mthong snang dang*/ rang sgra sogs kyi rkyen byas nas bla ma dang yi dam dang dbang bskur ba rnams dran zhing gsol ba btab pas/ lhan skyes kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum du byon nas/ rdo rje'i ming nas bos te mkha' spyod du 'khrid par mdzad do/ /de tsam ni bum dbang thob nas bskyed rim sgom pa tsam la'ang 'byung la/

'ga' zhig mngal skyes su skye 'gyur gyi pha ma'i kun sbyor mthong zhing*/ skye gnas nye bar dmigs pa na dbang gsum pa dang 'brel bar chags lam gyi gnad kyis grol ba'am/ gsang dbang dang 'brel bar grol lam pa'i gnad kyis grol pa'ang yod cing*/ bar do nyid du rang stobs kyis rim gnyis sgom pas grol ba'ang yod la/ thams cad kyang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis brda dang brda'i lan bstan te spyod pa gsum spyad pa la brten nas/ sa bcu bgrod par bzhed do/ /༈ gnyis pa pho nya'i lam la brten pa la'ang*/ gtum mo'i tshab tu pho nya'i lam sbyar ba ma gtogs/ rlung dang rtsa dang thig le dang mi rtog pa rtsa ba'i man ngag dang*/ rmi lam la sogs pa 'phros don gyi gdams ngag thams cad ni 'dra la/ gdam pa dngos ni man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis te/ sdom ni/ rlung sbyangs pa dang yid rig bsgom/ /yul ni brtag dang dgug pa dang*/ /rtsa bskyed pa dang sgyu ma sbyangs/ /'di dag sbyor ba'i chos drug yin/ /dbab dang gzungs dang bzlog pa dang*/ khyab dang rlung dang bsre ba dang*/ /dbyings su skyal ba zhes bya ba/ /'di dag dngos gzhi'i chos drug yin/ /zhes pa ltar te pho nya lam slong gi yi ge zur du gzhugs pa dang*/ zhal las shes par bya'o/ /༈ rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi 'khrid ni/ gegs bsal ba dang bogs dbyungs ba dang*/ 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul te gsum las/ dang po la man ngag gi gnad bcu gnyis te/ ro snyoms gnyis/ yi ge bzhi/ go cha drug go /ro snyoms dang po 'byung bzhi ro snyoms ni/ smras pa/ sa rgyas lus sems lci ba na/ /rlung dkyil steng du rkang pa bzhag /ba dan g.yo bas 'degs par bsgom/ /rlung rgyas yengs yengs 'gro 'dod sogs/ /lte bar sa dkyil cher 'ched nas/ /snang ba gser du gyur par bsam/ /chu rgyas drod nyams grangs shum byed/ /gsang bar me dkyil sgom pas sel/ /me rgyas tshad pa 'phel ba na/ /snying gar chu dkyil dkar la bsil/

/mched nas snang ba chu ru bsgom/ /'gyur ba bgegs la gzer bzhis sdeb/ /snying ga'i mdun rgyab na ba na/ /bu ga ha ra phyung dod pa'am/ /yang na bu ga mang po bsgom/ /thog mar phyi ru drod byung na/ /nang du bsdud pa'i man ngag bya/ /stod du 'chugs na yal 'gro bas/ /drod de lte bar 'bebs par bya/ /stong nyams skyes nas skrag pa na/ /sna rtser yung dkar bsgoms pas sel/ /rags pa'i rlung ni rnam shes dang*/ /bsre ba'i gdams pa gzhan yang yod/ /ro snyoms gnyis pa dmigs pas ro snyoms pa ni/ nyams kyi ro snyoms pa dang*/ sems kyi ro snyoms pa ste/ dang po ni/ snying gar bla ma lte bar me/ nad rnams de yi bar du 'dus/ /gsol ba btab la bar rlung brgyangs/ /nad bsdu ba'o/ /me 'bar nad rnams bsreg par bsam/ /na sar rlung sdigs sprug 'khor bya/ nad bsad pa'o/ /rgyu ma'i sna nas rlung bus pas/ /nad rnams phyir song hi zhes brjod/ nad bshig pa'o/ /nad la gzo bcos med par bzhag /nang stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'o/ /sems kyi ro snyoms pa ni/ gegs thams cad sems su shes/ sems stong pa/ stong pa gnyis med/ gnyis med 'od gsal du ngo sprod pa'o/ /yi ge bzhi'i gegs sel ba ni/ ske yan chad na na mgo bo la bug pa bcu gnyis bsgoms te hig brjod/ ro stod na na ro stod dang lag sor la bu ga mang po bsgoms te ha 'don/ ro smad na na smad dang rkang pa la bu ga mang po bsgom te a bzlas/ lus thams cad na na bu ga mang po'i sbyor bas hūṃ nyer gcig 'don no/ /go cha drug gi dang po stong pa'i go cha ni/ gang na de stong par bsgoms la rlung bzung zhing 'bud/ lus thams cad na na sor mo'i rtse mo nas brtsams te nyam pa la chad de lus thams cad zhig par bsam/ khog nang mi bde na dgang thon la bslab/ des sel/ 'dis 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'grai/ gnyis pa bde ba'i go cha ni/ gang na sar thig le dkar dmar ril ma tsam bsam/

de'i 'od kyis sangs par bsgoms/ gsum pa gtum mo'i go cha ni/ lus khol bur na na gang na sar a shad bsgoms/ spyir na na lte bar me gru gsum las me lce 'phros/ bu ga dgu nas nad thams cad 'das nas bsregs par bsam/ mthar me de lte ba'i me la bsdu/ bzhi pa sems kyi go cha ni nad la sogs pa gegs thams cad rang sems su shes pa dang*/ sgyu ma lta bur dmigs nas rlung bzungs te lus sprugs pas sel/ lnga pa bla ma'i go cha ni/ gang na sar bla ma bsgoms/ de'i 'od kyis nad dag par bsam/ mthar spyi bor bla ma bsgoms te gsol ba drag tu gdab/ de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ nad rnams 'og sgo nas thon par bsam/ yang na nad rnams sdig sgrib dag par byed pas bla ma'i 'phrin las su shes pa'ang yin gsungs/ drug pa yi dam gyi go cha ni/ bla ma'i gnas su yi dam sbyar ba nyid do/ /bcu gnyis po 'di dang 'brel ba'i gegs sel thor bu pa mang du yod pa ni khrid yig dkyus la mi gsungs pas/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bogs 'don ni/ spyod pa rnam pa gsum yin la/ de'i rnam par gzhag pa yang gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa 'bras bu 'grub pa'i tshul ni bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa la legs par 'bad pas/ rim pa bzhi'i rtogs pa gong nas gong du rgyud la skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ gsang rim gyi rtogs pa dang po skyes pa na/ bzod pa thob/ gsang rim mthar phyin pa na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam gyi sne zin/ slob pa'i zung 'jug 'grub/ slar yang zung du 'jug pa'i lam nyid kyi sa bcu'am bcu gnyis bsgrod pa'i mthar/ 'bras bu sku bzhi ye shes lnga yan lag bdun ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sku dang 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa thob pa yin no/ /rgyud don 'jig rten khams ltar rgya che ba/ /grub gzhung nyi 'od lta bus gsal mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam chen bla na med/

/brjod bral 'di yang skal ldan 'ga' la srid/ /de ltar bshad pa'i dge ba yis/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la/ /da lta nyid du 'khor gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang lha gzigs rigs kyi thig le/ rigs sngags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba sa skyongs mi dbang gang gis bkas/ bde mchog nag po lam slongs rgyas pa'i khrid yig tshig tshogs zor yangs pa la brten pa zhig yi ger bris shig ces bstsal ba la brten nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas mdo tsam brjod pa'o// //dag zhus/ dge legs 'phel// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/grub pa'i slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa'i dgongs don rim bzhi lam slongs snying po dril ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 302--PAGE 303--PAGE 276-
